title: A guide to native advertising (with examples)

facts.fact: Bazaarvoice, citing its own Bazaarvoice Network data, reports a 135% increase in conversion rate when shoppers engage with content from their peers.
facts.quote: From our own Bazaarvoice Network data, we see a 135% increase in conversion rate when shoppers engage with content from their peers

facts.fact: Bazaarvoice, citing its own Bazaarvoice Network data, reports a 164% increase in revenue per visitor when shoppers engage with content from their peers.
facts.quote: and a 164% increase in revenue per visitor

facts.fact: U.S. native advertising spend reached nearly $53 billion by the end of 2020, according to Statista as cited on the page.
facts.quote: Native advertising spend in the U.S. has been on a steady incline since 2016, reaching nearly $53 billion

facts.fact: According to Outbrain, native ads are 62% easier to comprehend than display ads.
facts.quote: native ads are 62% easier to comprehend than display ads, and 31% easier than social ads

facts.fact: According to Outbrain, native ads are 31% easier to comprehend than social ads.
facts.quote: native ads are 62% easier to comprehend than display ads, and 31% easier than social ads

facts.fact: In a Kantar study cited on the page, brand awareness increased by 25% when participants engaged with native video ads.
facts.quote: brand awareness increased by 25% when participants engaged with native video ads

facts.fact: In an Outbrain study cited on the page, 68% of consumers trust native advertising in an editorial context, compared to 55% for social media ads.
facts.quote: found that 68% of consumers trust native advertising in an editorial context, compared to 55% for social media ads

facts.fact: The page states that native ads increase purchase intent by 18%, without naming a specific source.
facts.quote: native ads increase purchase intent by 18%

facts.fact: The guide was published on December 14, 2022, by Kerry Bridge.
facts.quote: Published: December 14, 2022 Authored By: Kerry Bridge
